lines.t: In the quiet of your morning
When the world is still and slow
You invite me to your resting place
Where living waters gently flow
Here my heart lays down its worries
Here my soul finds breath again
In the warmth of holy silence
I am held within your hands
Sabbath light is falling softly
Peace like sunlight on my skin In Your presence I am calm, Lord
All the storms grow quiet within Here I'm safe and here I'm resting
Take every burden you undo
Sabbath whispers in the stillness
I am making all things new
All the noise of earthly trouble
We are now at Upper Session Road
Your fear is washed away
For your love becomes my shelter
And my dawn is found in you
And I breathe in your kindness
I breathe out the weight I've carried
Your peace is the song of the garden
Where my soul is gently married
To the rest You wrote for me
From the beginning of all days
Sabbath light is falling softly
Peace like sunlight on my skin
In Your presence I am whole, Lord
And I'm coming home again
Here I'm safe and here I'm resting
Every shadow You undo
do sabbath whispers in the stillness i am making all things new
Ooh, ooh, ooh
